daily_narrative.happened: U.S. equities finished mixed, with the S&P 500 flat and Nasdaq slightly higher while small caps lagged; the move appears to reflect post-rally rotation out of high-beta tech and semis after the U.S.-Iran de-escalation/oil drop narrative and ahead of the Fed.[1][3][5] The regime still looks transitional: volatility is collapsing, but leadership remains narrow, with technology, momentum and value outperforming while growth lags, which matches today’s sector split and the sharp selloff in names like MRVL and INTC.[1][3][5]
